	"strings"

	var t string

package main

import (
	"fmt"
)

func main() {
	var n int
	var t string
	fmt.Scan(&n, &t)
	
	// Convert to byte slice for mutation
	b := []byte(t)
	
	for i := 2; i <= n; i++ {

			// Indices 0 to i-1
			for l, r := 0, i-1; l < r; l, r = l+1, r-1 {

			}
		}
	}
	
	fmt.Println(string(b))
}

Your task is to decrypt this string, i.e., to find a string $$$s$$$ such that the above algorithm results in string $$$t$$$. It can be proven that this string $$$s$$$ always exists and is unique.
